description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Lahar travel-time zones support the provider-defined calculation of warning and evacuation time. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including ELTT, NISQ_WHITE, TIME_ZONE. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for emergency response studies. The estimates concern lahars of 10 to 100 million cubic metres and fastest estimated arrival, not an observed event forecast. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
